CtaBand.headline: Got a project in mind? Let’s <highlight>talk</highlight>.

hero.title: Websites built like <green>products</green>, not brochures.
hero.lead: We design and build modern websites, landing pages, and digital products for local and service-based businesses — functional from day one, built to grow.

why.title: The <red>businesses</red> that grow fastest aren’t always the best. They’re <underline>the clearest</underline>.
why.body: A strong digital brand isn’t about looking nice — it’s about being instantly understood. When your website, your content and your presence all say the same thing clearly, people trust you faster, hesitate less, and choose you instead of the next tab over.

points.second: Consistency builds trust faster than content

services.title: One <green>studio</green>, the full stack of your digital presence.

philosophy.title: We don’t <red>guess</red> what your business needs. We <underline>ask</underline>.
philosophy.body: Every NortBrand project starts with a real conversation — about your customers, your goals, and what success actually looks like for your business. That’s how we make sure what we build doesn’t just look good, it performs.

points.first: Every project starts with a conversation, not a template
points.second: Design decisions are tied to your actual business goals
points.third: Success is measured in results, not just good looks

process.title: A clear process, from first call to launch.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: We start by understanding your business, your customers, and what success actually looks like for you.

design.title: Design
design.body: A clear visual direction and structure, built around your content and your goals — not a template.

build.title: Build
build.body: A fast, reliable, functional website or product, built on solid technical foundations.

launch.title: Launch & Grow
launch.body: We launch, then keep improving — content, performance, and features that grow with your business.

hero.title: <red>Everything</red> your business needs to show up <green>online</green>.
hero.lead: From your first landing page to ongoing maintenance — pick what you need now, add the rest as you grow.
hero.quote: The businesses that grow fastest aren’t always the best. They’re the clearest.

webDesign.title: Interfaces People Actually <greenUnderline>Enjoy</greenUnderline> Using
webDesign.details: Clean, modern interfaces built around your business and your customers — not a template with your logo on it. Every layout decision ties back to what you actually need people to do.

webDevelopment.title: Built to Perform, Built to <greenUnderline>Last</greenUnderline>
webDevelopment.details: Fast, reliable builds with real product architecture underneath, ready to grow with you — from a simple landing page to a full booking system.

contentWriting.title: Words That Do Their <greenUnderline>Job</greenUnderline>
contentWriting.details: Clear, on-brand copy that explains what you do and why it matters — without the filler. Every page says exactly what it needs to, and nothing more.

socialMedia.title: Stay Visible, Stay <greenUnderline>Consistent</greenUnderline>
socialMedia.details: Consistent, on-brand content that keeps your business visible between projects — so people don’t forget you exist the moment they leave your site.

maintenance.title: <greenUnderline>Peace of Mind</greenUnderline>, Built In
maintenance.details: Ongoing updates, monitoring, and small fixes, so your site keeps working as hard as you do — without you having to think about it.

approach.title: Every detail has a reason behind it.
approach.body: None of it is arbitrary. Here’s what actually goes into the work.

brandIdentity.title: Brand Identity
brandIdentity.body: Your logo, colors, and typography aren’t decoration — they’re the visual shorthand people use to recognize and trust you before they’ve read a single word.

visualDesign.title: Color & Visual Design
visualDesign.body: Color, type and spacing do quiet work: they guide the eye, signal what matters, and make your business feel the same everywhere it shows up.

contentStrategy.title: Content Strategy
contentStrategy.body: We plan what each page needs to say, and in what order, so visitors find their answers before they think to ask the question.

growth.title: Growth & Marketing
growth.body: Launch is the starting line. Search visibility, clear calls to action and simple measurement keep your site bringing in work long after day one.

cta.headline: Ready to pick your starting point?
cta.subtext: You don’t need all five services on day one. Book a free consultation and we’ll figure out what actually matters first.

hero.title: Digital work, designed with the <greenUnderline>same care</greenUnderline>.
hero.lead: NortBrand started with a simple belief: small businesses deserve digital experiences that are designed with the same care as the products and services they provide.

story.title: <green>More</green> than a finished project.
story.statement: NortBrand was created to approach digital work <red>differently</red>.
story.intro: Instead of starting with templates or trends, we start by understanding the business:
story.outro: From there, we shape the brand, experience, interface, and technology around that reality.

principle.title: Minimalism, but <indent><greenUnderline>functional</greenUnderline> products.</indent>
principle.body: Every NortBrand project should be clear, purposeful, and built around the people who will actually use it — whether that means a focused business website today or a complete digital product that grows into bookings, customer experiences, and mobile applications tomorrow.

cta.headline: Let’s start with <highlight>your business</highlight>.
cta.subtext: Book a free consultation and tell us what your business does, who it serves, and what actually needs to work.

hero.title: Let’s start with a <greenUnderline>conversation</greenUnderline>.
hero.lead: Tell us a bit about your business and what you’re hoping to achieve. We’ll reply within one business day — no sales pitch, just a real answer.

request.title: You send a request
request.body: Fill in the form with a few details about your business and what you need. It takes about two minutes.

reply.title: We reply within a day
reply.body: A real person reads your message and replies with a few questions and some times that work for a call.

call.title: We talk it through
call.body: A relaxed 30-minute call to understand your goals. You’ll leave with a clear next step, whether or not we work together.

faq.title: Frequently asked <red>questions</red>
faq.body: Can’t find what you’re looking for? Send us a message and we’ll answer you directly.

cost.question: How much does a website cost?
cost.answer: It depends on scope. A focused landing page costs far less than a multi-page build with booking features. After a short call we send a clear, itemised proposal, with no hidden fees.

timeline.question: How long does a project take?
timeline.answer: It depends on scope and on how quickly content and feedback come together. The proposal includes a timeline with clear milestones, so you know what happens when.

content.question: Do I need to have my content ready?
content.answer: No. Bring what you have, and we’ll work out together what’s missing. Content writing is one of our services if you’d rather we handle it.

international.question: Do you work with businesses outside Portugal?
international.answer: Yes. We work in English and Portuguese, and calls happen online, so where your business is based isn’t a barrier.

afterLaunch.question: What happens after the site launches?
afterLaunch.answer: We don’t disappear. Website maintenance keeps your site updated, monitored and backed up, and we can keep improving it as your business grows.

Legal.questionsBody: Write to <email></email> and we’ll answer directly.

privacy.title: <greenUnderline>Privacy</greenUnderline> Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what personal information NortBrand collects through this website, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: NortBrand Studio (“NortBrand”, “we”, “us”) is a digital product and web design studio based in Portugal. We are responsible for the personal information collected through this website. You can reach us at <email></email>.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We only collect information you choose to give us, plus basic technical data needed to run the site.

items.contactForm: Contact details and messages you send through the contact form (name, email, phone number, project details)
items.newsletter: Your email address, if you subscribe to the newsletter
items.usage: Basic usage data such as pages visited and device type [analytics provider to be confirmed]

use.title: How we use your information
use.body: We use your information to reply to your enquiries, deliver the services you ask for, send the newsletter you subscribed to, and improve how this website works. We do not sell your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: We use one essential cookie, nb_consent, to remember your cookie choice for 6 months. Only with your consent, Google Analytics sets the _ga cookie and a _ga_ cookie named after our analytics property, to measure how the site is used; this data may be transferred to the United States. You can change your choice at any time from Cookie settings in the footer. [Cookie details to be confirmed.]

sharing.title: Sharing your information
sharing.body: We only share personal information with service providers who help us operate the website and our business, such as hosting and email providers, and only as needed to provide those services. [List of providers to be confirmed.]

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purposes described above, or as required by law. [Retention periods to be confirmed.]

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR you can ask to access, correct, delete, or export your personal information, and to object to or restrict how we use it. You can withdraw consent at any time, and you can lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority (CNPD).

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For any questions about this policy or your data, write to <email></email>.

terms.title: <greenUnderline>Terms</greenUnderline> of Use
terms.lead: By using this website you agree to the terms below. We’ve kept them clear and short, because they’re meant to be read.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using the NortBrand website, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the site.

use.title: Using the website
use.body: You may use this website for lawful purposes only. Please don’t attempt to disrupt the site, access areas you aren’t authorised to, or use it in a way that harms NortBrand or other visitors.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, and designs, belongs to NortBrand or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy or reuse it without written permission.

enquiries.title: Enquiries and proposals
enquiries.body: Sending a contact request doesn’t create a client relationship. Any project work is covered by a separate written agreement. [To be confirmed.]

links.title: Third-party links
links.body: This website may link to third-party sites. We aren’t responsible for their content or privacy practices.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: We do our best to keep the information on this website accurate and up to date, but we provide it “as is”, without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, NortBrand is not liable for losses arising from your use of the site. [To be reviewed by legal counsel.]

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page, with the date of the last update.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal. [Jurisdiction to be confirmed.]

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Write to <email></email>.
